📋 NEXT STEPS

  1. Click folder bars above to see subfolders and top files
  2. Click "Reveal in Finder" button - copies command to clipboard
  3. Open Terminal (Cmd+Space, type "Terminal") and paste (Cmd+V), press Enter
  4. Finder opens with the file/folder selected
  5. Delete files manually (send to Trash for safe undo)
  6. Start with largest items - easiest wins first

⚠️ Important: Ask Dad does not delete files for you, you must delete files manually from Finder. Don't empty Trash until you are sure you want it gone for good.
